title: Custom Algebra Game
description: An example custom game demonstrating how anyone can define new mathematical worlds and levels in pure JSON.
author: Community Creator

worlds.name: Algebraic Identities
worlds.description: Foundational identities in commutative rings and monoids.

levels.title: Right identity of addition
levels.doc: Prove that adding zero to any natural number leaves it unchanged.
hints: Use the Peano axiom add_zero: x + 0 = x

levels.title: Chained zeroes
levels.doc: Prove that adding zero twice leaves the number unchanged.
hints: Rewrite with add_zero once for the outer addition, then once more for the inner addition.
